regime_context: The detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the leading eligible theme (trending, not crowded) with rotation narrowing and no one-narrative regime; Pharma & CXO is the crowded challenger. However, the China backtest says the absolute-trend gate did not cut drawdown here and momentum rank is attention only, so any directional read is low confidence.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed Pharma/CXO challenge: if Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) outperforms 515000.SS for five consecutive sessions while AI Compute does not reclaim rank 1 during that stretch, that would retire the watch as a confirmed handoff; otherwise AI Compute leadership remains intact.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the ranking eligible theme with a trend tag and no crowding flag. The lean is a conditional vol-aware preference, not a return forecast: I would lean overweight only while it holds above CSI 300 and no confirmed challenger handoff appears.
evidence: rotation.leader=AI Compute & Optics; margin=0.48 over Pharma/CXO
